description: Land Title Settlement Department - Siyambalagasthenna, Gagawatakoralaya D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320410 (7715)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations and amendments under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries detailing specific amendments to land title records, including changes to ownership details, servitude rights, and national identity card numbers associated with land parcels. The content focuses entirely on land property matters, cadastral mapping, and title registration adjustments, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). There is no government personnel or structural content that would trigger Types 1-3, and the subject matter is specifically land-related rather than commercial, legal, or other specialized categories.
